exposure: Fetoscopic laser photocoagulation (FLP) for twin-to-twin transfusion syndrome (TTTS)
cohort: 30 women with monochorionic diamniotic twin pregnancy with TTTS who underwent FLP at 16-26 weeks of gestation
finding: Maternal changes in anemia and coagulation/fibrinolysis after FLP for TTTS returned to normal spontaneously within 2 weeks.
